in_sanskrit.name: Imtayaz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gift from God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Imtayaz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Imtayaz is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the Arabic words ‘imtī’ meaning gift and ‘yaz’ meaning God. The name is used in Hindu culture to signify a gift bestowed by the divine. It is a spiritual name that carries the significance of being a blessing from the Almighty.
